unlisted_practices: Using an LLM-as-a-Judge to automate quality evaluation of AI-generated EHR summaries, benchmarked against human raters using the PDSQI instrument
Comparing reasoning, non-reasoning, task-trained, and multi-agent LLM judges for inter-rater reliability with human evaluators

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an automated LLM-as-a-Judge method as a scalable deployment/evaluation practice to assess the quality and safety of AI-generated clinical EHR summaries compared to human expert benchmarks.

primary.practice: automated LLM-as-a-judge quality and safety evaluation
